episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Rosie defies the Fellowship's orders to search the forest for her missing daughter — only to encounter a mysterious outsider who seems sent from above.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While Rosie fights the temptation of forbidden fruit, her husband Adam must make a difficult decision to prove himself worthy of a divine opportunity.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Transgressions within the Fellowship lead to severe punishment. A frightening event buys Rosie unexpected bargaining power in exchange for her silence.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As a fresh recruit of the Fellowship attracts unwanted attention, Rosie sets her sights on a thrilling new experience beyond the community confines.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Questions of loyalty, power and sin emerge in the wake of a tragic incident, sparking a big change in the community and a tense search for answers.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: When little Grace's safety becomes uncertain once again, Rosie's rising suspicions lead to a chilling question: who is the true devil among them?
